tips.text: Keep the quest blueprint; rebuying it from Simaris costs 100,000 standing.
Bring a decent AoE frame to clear the Guardian and Jester pairs.
Bring Nekros to the Siphons; older threads report about 3 parts per siphon.
Players treat Orvius as a low-effort Mastery item; the only friction is part imbalance if you farm in the wrong mode.
